title: Technical Product Manager - Consumer Platforms
company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

 

The Role 

Joining the Consumer Platforms team, you’ll help make Rightmove fast, consistent and easy to build on, so that our consumer product teams can ship great experiences with confidence. The team owns the shared foundations behind our website and apps: SEO and AI discoverability, site performance and accessibility, the design system, cross-team technical standards, client storage and analytics and tracking, and the third-party tooling that powers experimentation and CRM. 

Your customers are mostly internal: Product Managers, Engineers, Security, and Data and Analytics colleagues. You’ll learn where they struggle, turn that into a clear roadmap, and prove the impact in terms of both team productivity and outcomes.

title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges.

Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally.
  • Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability.
  • Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (German Speaking)
description:
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will proactively drive new product attachment and effective strong relationships across our largest and most strategic customers. You’ll advocate for the customer internally and focus on a positive customer experience. Interactions are rooted in relationship-management, first and foremost, while also advocating for growth opportunities. Enterprise Customer Success Managers follow a well-defined methodology that helps them identify the customer's unique needs and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 What You’ll Do:

  • Act as a strategic partner to customers, orchestrating cross-functional internal teams and engaging executive, technical, and business stakeholders to understand customer goals and translate them into a clear, deliverable Datadog value narrative.
  • Proactively build and maintain executive relationships to deliver clear, outcome-driven value stories that connect Datadog technical use cases to measurable business results.
  • Lead QBRs and strategic reviews as a forum to demonstrate impact, align on priorities, and define next-step initiatives.

title: Senior Commercial Account Executive (DACH)
description:
As a Senior Commercial Account Executive (SCAE) on our Commercial Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across small to midsize markets. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. AEs have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity
  • Become a Datadog expert through continued product and sales trainings
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including technical demonstrations and negotiations 
  • Handle larger, more complex deals with longer sales cycles with autonomy
  • Informally coach/ mentor other Account Executives on closing deals and more complex negotiations 
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity
  • Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end-users
  • Be a visible proponent and mentor for targeting, territory, and funnel management within the sales organization
  • Always maintains a well balanced pipeline with an appropriate number of opportunities at each stage to maximize personal productivity
  • Demonstrates superior judgment about when to "walk-away" from unattractive opportunities
  • Proven ability to navigate complex sales cycles

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

About Physical AI

CoreWeave's Physical AI team helps companies apply AI to the physical systems they design, test, and operate, across automotive, industrial, robotics, and autonomous vehicles (AV).

We work as one cross-functional team of product, design, engineering, and forward-deployed engineers, partnering directly with our customers' engineering teams.

Our focus is twofold: making AI usable for engineers who know their machines in depth but are not ML specialists, and supporting robotics and AV teams across the full development loop, from sensor data and simulation to model training and evaluation.

What You’ll Do:

As a Staff Product Designer on the Physical AI team, you will lead design across our portfolio of Physical AI products, turning complex data and ML workflows into tools that engineers who build vehicles, machines, and robots trust and use every day.
